description: Check whether a cartridge+powder pair RESOLVES in the served database and whether the published-reference corpus contains a row for the pair (nearest-bullet membership — the same membership that decides a ladder's basis). Answers membership and canonical identity ONLY; it never serves the corpus row's numbers. Identity + published dimensional metadata only — NOT load data (rights-class discipline): no charge/velocity/pressure values are served by this tool.

bullet_gr.description: Bullet weight in grains (optional; enables corpus-membership answer)

name: check_component_compatibility
